systemic_note: The 1.21.11 template is nearly code-identical to its first child in level/: the 16 differing files differ almost entirely in comment renames, with exactly THREE real code diffs, all matching vanilla 1.21.11's own changes (sea pickle .equals(), jukebox pop position, turtle hatch default 0.0). The class aliases and hardcoded forms were already in the template. The absent-tag root cause is unchanged (204 tags, one new: can_glide_through, out of scope): the port's 26.x-shaped tag reads are the single root cause of G04, G08, G09, G11, G13, G19, G21, G24, G37-G42.
